title: Ours go to 211: Euler pseudoprimes to 47 prime bases (from Carmichael numbers)
summary: In this paper we show that a certain subset of the Carmichael numbers contains good Euler pseudoprimes, composite numbers that for many bases survive the Solovay-Strassen primality test. We present a classification of Carmichael numbers, and use the knowledge gained from this to create a fast algorithm to compute new Euler pseudoprimes, by multiplying already found Euler pseudoprimes. We use this algorithm to find many Euler pseudoprimes that are pseudoprimes for several consecutive prime bases starting at 2, hence for all integer bases up to that number.
